WOLV Token

The native profit token of WolvCapital. Fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 WOLV minted entirely at deployment. No mint function exists — supply is permanently capped. No owner, no pause, no admin controls of any kind.

Key Functions

burn(amount)
Holder can burn their own tokens
Access: Token holder
burnFrom(account, amount)
Burn from an approved account
Access: Approved spender
transfer(to, amount)
Standard ERC20 transfer
Access: Token holder
approve(spender, amount)
Approve spender allowance
Access: Token holder

Key Facts

Total supply: 1,000,000,000 WOLV (fixed forever)
No mint function — supply cannot increase
No owner — no admin key of any kind
No pause function — transfers can never be frozen
No blacklist, no fee, no tax on transfers

Reward Pool

✓ Verified
0x7310f3e07627ce98246973e068bf2ff294f84e5f
View Code ↗Read Contract ↗
BNB Smart Chain (BSC)Standard: CustomSolidity v0.8.28Source verified on Sourcify

Holds the WOLV reward supply for staker claims. Protected by a 48-hour timelock — no funds can leave the pool to the multisig without a mandatory 48-hour delay, visible on-chain the moment it's queued.

Key Functions

fund(amount)
Add WOLV to the reward pool (requires prior approval)
Access: Anyone
release(to, amount)
Release rewards to a staker
Access: StakingContract only
queueWithdraw(amount)
Queue an emergency withdrawal — starts 48hr timelock
Access: Multisig only
executeWithdraw()
Execute a queued withdrawal after 48hrs
Access: Multisig only
cancelWithdraw()
Cancel a queued withdrawal
Access: Multisig only
poolBalance()
View current WOLV in the pool
Access: Public

Key Facts

48-hour timelock on all multisig fund movements
Only StakingContract can call release()
Anyone can fund the pool — no gatekeeping
Pool balance publicly visible on BSCScan at all times
No user funds held — reward supply only

Staking Contract

✓ Verified
0x7cd22f3c08b4195225da7d043cbe00da118d31ec
View Code ↗Read Contract ↗
BNB Smart Chain (BSC)Standard: CustomSolidity v0.8.28Source verified on Sourcify

Manages WOLV staking positions across four tiers, funded with BNB or BUSD. Integrates Chainlink price feeds for USD-denominated stake sizing and rewards. Handles stake deposits, lock periods, and reward claims via the RewardPool.

Key Functions

stakeBNB(planId)
Stake BNB into a plan (0–3)
Access: Anyone
stakeBUSD(planId, amount)
Stake BUSD into a plan (0–3)
Access: Anyone
claimRewards(stakeId)
Claim WOLV rewards after lock expires
Access: Staker
earlyExit(stakeId)
Exit before lock ends, principal minus exit fee
Access: Staker
pendingReward(user, stakeId)
View a stake's projected WOLV reward
Access: Public
getStake(user, stakeId)
View details of any stake
Access: Public

Key Facts

4 staking tiers: Pioneer, Vanguard, Horizon, Summit VIP
APY range: 8% – 25%
Chainlink oracle for BNB/USD price feeds
Lock periods: 90 / 150 / 180 / 365 days
Reward rate locked in per-stake at the time you stake — later rate changes never affect existing stakes
Rewards paid from timelock-protected RewardPool
No admin can access staker principal — only a pause switch
